fact: Statistics South Africa published Mortality and causes of death in South Africa: Findings from death notification, 2023 (P0309.3) on 25 March 2026, based on the Department of Home Affairs civil registration death notification forms (BI-1663 and DHA-1663), with trends for 2002-2022.
title: Mortality and causes of death in South Africa: Findings from death notification, 2023
